title: ICH M15 Guideline: General Principles for Model-Informed Drug Development

content.abstract_summary: Final ICH M15 guidance provides harmonized recommendations for planning, evaluating, documenting, communicating, and submitting MIDD evidence. It explicitly applies to current and emerging modeling approaches, including AI/ML.
key_findings: M15 is a final general-principles framework for MIDD evidence assessment.
It applies to AI/ML used alone or with other M&S approaches.
Early planning and regulatory communication are encouraged for MIDD strategies.
limitations: General guidance; it does not prescribe hybrid-model-specific identifiability, UQ, or lifecycle acceptance thresholds.

gaps_addressed: Harmonized MIDD evidence planning, evaluation, documentation, and regulatory communication for AI/ML
